mechanism: Prednisone may increase infection risk and mask symptoms of infection, while piperacillin-tazobactam efficacy may be reduced by corticosteroid-induced immunosuppression; additionally, corticosteroids can increase risk of adverse effects from beta-lactam antibiotics.
action: Monitor clinical response to antibiotic therapy closely and assess for signs of inadequate infection control; continue prednisone at necessary therapeutic dose while ensuring appropriate antibiotic dosing and duration.
